canada.title: N.S. government still working to restore websites affected by programming vulnerability
canada.summary: It could be several weeks before all of the Nova Scotia government’s websites are back online after some were pulled down in response to a warning about a security vulnerability.

canada.title: Property tax hike included in Gillingham’s costed platform
canada.summary: Scott Gillingham will raise property taxes 3.5 per cent in 2027, if he’s re-elected as mayor on Wednesday.

canada.title: Brampton man arrested, charged in connection with fatal stabbing in Mississauga
canada.summary: A 35-year-old Brampton man has been arrested and charged in the stabbing death of a 47-year-old Bradford, Ont., man in Mississauga over the weekend.

canada.title: 'It's time to abolish the Indian Act,' Manitoba premier tells PM during meeting with chiefs
canada.summary: Manitoba Premier Wab Kinew says he told Prime Minister Mark Carney that Canada should abolish the Indian Act during a historic meeting with premiers and First Nations leaders.

canada.title: N.B. students unsure about federal bill to ban social media for youth under 16
canada.summary: Two students, one at Fredericton High School and one at Mount Allison University, agree that social media platforms are flawed, but disagree that a proposed solution to ban youth under 16 is the way to go.

canada.title: Reading 9 to 5: N.W.T. one step closer to enrolling all preschoolers in Dolly’s Imagination Library
canada.summary: Fundraisers on Give Like Dolly Day successfully funded every kid in Hay River. Organizers across the territory say they’re not done yet.

canada.title: Montreal police officer who allegedly urinated on homeless people faces ethics probe
canada.summary: Guy Lapointe Jr., Quebec's new domestic security, said both the police ethics commissioner and the province's independent police watchdog, known as the BEI, will look into the allegations.

canada.title: Police locate vehicle in Scarborough parental abduction investigation
canada.summary: Police received a call about three young children who were allegedly abducted just after 11:30 a.m. on Friday in Scarborough.

canada.title: There’s disappointment and hope among Albertans who supported the idea of independence

canada.title: Ex-N.S. PC interim leader endorses another former Tory for Liberal leadership

canada.title: Alberta referendum tallies reveal rural-urban divide on ‘the 9’
